elements.problem: 'Unable to walk' is right, but 'Difficulty walking' was added as an alternative trigger. Difficulty walking is much broader than 'unable to walk unaided' (any gait difficulty), so a patient who walks unaided with mild difficulty would be flagged Urgent for admission. The page's criterion (cannot walk without help) is not the same as difficulty walking.
evidence: Urgent: RR-TB routine care with criteria for hospital admission :: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Difficulty walking" "finding")) (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Unable to walk" "finding"))

summary: The red box and the Symptoms-row urgent list are encoded faithfully at Urgent with correct thresholds (RR >= 30, BMI < 18; Hb < 8 rightly omitted as not representable). The main errors are over-broad concepts: 'Difficulty walking' added for 'unable to walk unaided', and 'Hemoptysis' with no '>= 1 tablespoon' quantity, both of which over-trigger Urgent. Unstable social circumstances and infection-control challenges are missing (borderline), and the BP >= 140/90 and palliative-care criteria are not encoded (borderline cross-references).
